description: This file contains the implementation of the 'Topic' module controller in the OpenCart admin extension. It defines a class extending the base controller, with methods for displaying the module's configuration page ('index') and saving settings ('save'). The code manages loading language strings, setting up breadcrumbs, rendering views, and handling POST requests to update module settings.

classes.name: Topic
classes.description: Controller class for managing the 'Topic' module in the OpenCart admin extension. Handles rendering the module configuration page and saving user settings.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the module configuration page, initializes language, sets the page title, constructs breadcrumbs, loads header, column, footer, and renders the view with data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles POST request to save the module's settings. Checks user permissions, updates settings via model, and returns a JSON response indicating success or failure.
